landing.headline: Every child. Every stop. Every day.
landing.subline: SafeRide helps schools and parents know where the school bus is and that every child got on and off safely.

parents.title: For parents
parents.b1: Get a message when your child gets on and off the bus
parents.b2: Follow the bus live on a map while your child is on board
parents.b3: Know when the bus is about 10 minutes away

helpers.title: For bus helpers
helpers.b1: Do roll call and tick children on and off in a few taps
helpers.b2: Works with a weak connection and syncs when you are back online
helpers.b3: Clear lists by stop, with photos
helpers.note: Your school registers your phone number first.

schools.title: For schools
schools.b1: Manage students, buses, stops and routes in one place
schools.b2: Watch every bus live and get alerts when something looks wrong
schools.b3: A full record of every pickup and drop-off

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This placeholder explains how SafeRide handles personal data. The final text will be written with legal advice before launch.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: We collect names of students and guardians, phone numbers, and the bus location during active trips only. We do not track anyone outside a trip.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: Parents see only their own children. Bus helpers see the students on their trips. School administrators see their own school. Nobody else has access.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Detailed location history is deleted after a retention period set by the school. Trip records are kept for the school's audit needs.

children.title: Children's data
children.body: Children's data is added by the school and shared only with their verified guardians. Children do not use the app.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: Placeholder: the governing law and jurisdiction will be confirmed by counsel.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These placeholder terms describe how SafeRide may be used. The final terms will be reviewed by counsel.

use.title: Using the service
use.body: The service is for schools, their bus helpers and registered guardians. Accounts must not be shared.

accuracy.title: Accuracy and availability
accuracy.body: Locations and arrival times are estimates and may be delayed. The service does not replace the school's own safety procedures.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. Continued use means you accept the updated terms.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: Placeholder: the governing law and jurisdiction will be confirmed by counsel.
